_asserts: A zero limit yields a nil percent — not a division-by-zero, NaN, infinity, or a synthesised 0.
`isReportable` is false: no positive cap and no spend, so the render rule hides the row even though parsing succeeded.

The parser must not itself suppress the credits object — 'a zero budget' (present, hidden) stays distinct from 'no cap' (limitMinor null, see credits-uncapped) and from 'nothing at all' (credits null).
percent, percentDisplay and remainingMinor are absent from this file on purpose: absence asserts nil.
